description: Computes the selected bodies, then returns every pairwise angular separation in degrees. Useful for astronomy, historical reconstruction, rendering, research, and event-planning agents. It returns geometry only, with no predictive or interpretive claims. Price: $0.02 USDC per call after 25 free calls per day.

_payment.description: x402 v2 payment: base64 PaymentPayload, as you would send in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Only needed after the free allowance is used.
